svg.title: influxdata/influxdb: 67% AI-signed commits
svg.desc: 67% of 3 recent commits in influxdata/influxdb carry a disclosed AI agent signature (3 commits, last 90 days). GitHub Copilot 33%, Cursor 33%. No signature found does not mean human-only.
